title: Rows of flimsy houses with gaping doors.
html_source:
The “gaping doors” have obvious sexual connotations, but it’s the flimsy houses which form the more potent image.

The houses are poorly constructed, perhaps, but their flimsiness foreshadows the way reality will be warped to breaking point in this chapter.

(The Mabbot street entrance of nighttown, before which stretches an uncobbled tramsiding set with skeleton tracks, red and green will-o'-the-wisps and danger signals.
anchor.suffix: Rare lamps with faint rainbow fins. Round Rabaiotti's halted ice gondola stunted men and women squabble. They grab wafers between which are wedged lumps of coral and copper snow.
